items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: And you see, Rust didn't do it when we were playing it.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's it. He said, man I heard that Climax Rag, you know. He says, you like that tune. And he said, we played it all the time. He said, I heard you steal that from me. That's what he said anyway. But he said, it's a trombone partner that you didn't play. And he was talking to a trombone man. And he sang it to him, see. And Rusty didn't get it the first time around. He's like me, it takes about 20 times around and doesn't really get it. But then once he gets it, he usually remembers it. And it's things like…
It was down here but not much. Yeah. I know.
